simple.meaning: גְּדַד (gᵉdad) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to cut down.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Daniel, beginning at Daniel 4:11. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גְּדַד (H1414) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: גְּדַד (gᵉdad) / H1414 is traced through Daniel 4:11, Daniel 4:20 with source-language evidence and verse context.
